data.name: LOST ZION
data.detailed_description:
PLAY THE DEMO now for FREE ---> download DEMO button

       LOST ZION is an Advanced Walking-Simulator Retro-Futuristic Psychological Horror designed to feel like playing inside a movie from the First Person Perspective where every step is your choice. 

Awaken in the Shadows of a Fallen Megacity

       You awaken as a mysterious Service Bot Unit inside a massive decaying city where almost nothing is explained. Your only clear objective is to activate the Gravity Core. As you descend deeper into the city, repairing systems and overcoming obstacles, you slowly uncover who activated you… and why.

     - Inspired by classic science fiction, dystopian cyberpunk, and cinematic storytelling, LOST ZION focuses heavily on atmosphere, immersion, mystery, and emotional world-building. Every district, machine, and environment is handcrafted to create the feeling of exploring a forgotten future.

  • Created by a solo indie developer with over 15 years of experience in filmmaking, photography, music production, and visual design, LOST ZION blends cinematic direction with retro-futuristic aesthetics to deliver a unique immersive experience.

  • This is only the beginning of a much larger interconnected universe planned across multiple future games and perspectives inside the city of LOST ZION.

Core Gameplay: Immersive Exploration & Interaction

Engage in tense, first-person environmental psychological horror through hands-on discovery:

  • Dynamic Traversal: Walk, use traversal devices/vehicles, epic lifts, doors, and environmental tools to navigate the massive, lore-rich city.

  • Deep Interactions: Manipulate objects, hack terminals, converse with "spectral" characters, and solve physics-based puzzles amid escalating dread.

  • Survival Tension: Evade threats through stealth and wits—no guns, pure vulnerability as a fragile bot. But with the capacity to REPAIR certain obstacles 

           Atmospheric Cyberpunk Nightmare

Blade Runner meets TRON in a "present yet not" dystopia: retro-futuristic grit, glowing megastructures, perpetual rain-slicked alleys, and glitchy holograms. Physical horror blends with illusions, deception, and mind-bending glitches, backed by a haunting synth soundtrack that builds unrelenting dread.

Rich Storytelling

Environmental narrative unfolds via logs, artifacts, and branching discoveries—piecing together Lost Zion's downfall without heavy cutscenes. Multiple secrets, hidden paths, and layers of lore reward thorough explorers. 8-12 hours for the main story

Solo-developed debut episode in an interconnected saga.

data.short_description: Lost Zion is an atmospheric cyberpunk horror game. Awakened by a faint signal as a service bot, explore the forsaken megacity of Lost Zion. Uncover the Emperor's horrific secrets. Obey your sole command: Activate the Gravity Core.

  • Storage: 22 GB available space
